description: Bâtiments dune-polder zone de transition Westhoek is a dataset listed in data.gov.be, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Vlaamse Landmaatschappij. All buildings present in the transition area between the polder and the dunes in the Westhoek are refunded, based on the scanned aerial photographs on a scale of 1/6,000 (1990-1994). The buildings are coded by type. For the sake of user-friendliness, the area is divided into 5 parts. Coverage: Vlaamse Landmaatschappij. The portal shows the English title as "Buildings dune-polder transition zone Westhoek" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Vlaamse Landmaatschappij. Its keywords include DE WESTHOEK, DUINPOLDEROVERGANGSZONE, bap1do1-do5, HUISDO-DO, VLM, AFDELING LANDINRICHTING. The listing shows 1999-01-25 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support water network and flood-defence studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-data-gov-be.
